en: An illustrated postcard showing a mountainous landscape with forested slopes and a village in the foreground. There are several alpine-style houses with steep roofs and, on a nearby hill, a white church or chapel with a tower and spire. Autumnal trees in red and yellow hues dot the hillsides. In a white box on the right side is printed German text indicating the location, and at the bottom of the artwork is the artist's signature.
